name: Lair

components.pose: The dragon looms among its relics, wings half-folded like torn shadow, head lowered then raised toward the camera with a cold, knowing gaze, shadows pooling at its feet.
components.background: a vast crypt-vault beneath a ruined cathedral, ancient stone arches and sarcophagi, a faint violet glow filtering through cracked windows, drifting black smoke
components.hoard: black pearls and polished obsidian, tarnished silver crowns and candelabra, heaps of amethysts, cursed relics and ancient tomes, old coins and grave-goods
components.effects: A few soft wisps of shadow and a faint amethyst haze drift across the hoard - understated, nothing busy.

denoise: n/a — full text-to-image, no incoming reference
notes: Daily-post lair shot: the dragon at rest on the kind of hoard its element would collect.
